scope: Queue invocation external-fetch accounting and preservation of inconclusive source failures; no production replay or verifier version bump

cases.assertion: source requests share an invocation budget and interrupted candidates are not published
cases.baseline: 56 raw requests, including rejected requests after the simulated 50-request limit; all targets incorrectly completed/not_found
cases.candidate: 40 raw requests in first invocation; unfinished target stays unverified with no verification record; fresh invocation completes it without reprocessing terminal jobs

cases.assertion: failed discovery transport cannot become a not_found answer

addedCoverage: robots and each redirect hop metered below transport
durable continuation with no false candidate/source publication
single oversized target reaches existing bounded dead-letter path
validation.review: Reviewed all changed source, test, documentation and contract paths. No SQL/migration changes, no platform limit increase, no changes to existing load ceilings or fixtures. The policy update only registers two newly covered source files with the already executed queue suites.
limitations: CPU samples from isolated captures are local diagnostics; required CI owns paired six-session CPU evidence.
Budget interruption restarts only the incomplete target; repeated source reads and an extra wake are a safety tradeoff, not a claim of production load reduction.
Existing historical errors and suspect not_found results are not reset by this deployment.
